newsitem.title: UK: VFG Plc shares set small debut premium.
newsitem.headline: VFG Plc shares set small debut premium.

text.p: VFG plc shares set a slim premium on their first day of trade on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Thursday.
By 1200 GMT the shares were quoted at 41-1/2p, slightly ahead of their 40p placing price.
The company, which hires and sells broadcast video and film equipment, raised 3.0 million stg before expenses with the pre- float placing, valuing it at 5.7 million stg.
VFG said it was the UK's fourth largest television production hire company. t supplies equipment for the production of programmes including Coronation Street, Hollyoaks and Peak Practice.
VFG said it had offices in London, Manchester, Cardiff Bristol and Shepperton, and was well positioned to expand its hire business in both the regional and London markets.
An increasing amount of VFG's revenues has arisen from independent production companies as television production has fragmented since the 1991 Broadcasting Act, the company said.
IA Pritchard was broker to the issue, with Grant Thornton as the nominated adviser.
